about: Hand-checked menu pages per restaurant key (camis:... or csv:..., as in data/restaurants.json), applied by `pipeline sources` (see pipeline/sources.py load_menu_url_overrides): the page becomes the restaurant's menu_url, is scraped first and is trusted as this restaurant's menu; burger-list-master.csv is not edited. Use one when the page the list names (or the scrape found) is stale, partial or another restaurant's, and the restaurant's own current menu page (or, when it publishes none, this location's full menu on an ordering or delivery site) was checked by hand. A changed menu_url means a new scrape on the next `run` (credits); an override the list catches up with, or whose key leaves the scope, is reported as unused. Entries from the 2026-09-24 price check and unpriced-restaurant recovery, and from the 2026-09-25 review of each restaurant's one published burger, and from the 2026-09-25 additions of places named on critics' best-burger lists (Deux Luxe, Eel Bar).
